title: Make a Duck Hand. Can You SPREAD Your Fingers? 🦆
description:
Make a duck with your hand: big knuckles bent all the way, fingers straight. Now try to spread your fingers. Stuck? Each big knuckle has a strap on both sides. The bone end they wrap round bulges toward your palm, so when the knuckle bends, that bump pulls both straps tight and your fingers can't wiggle sideways. Flatten your hand and the straps go slack: now they spread.
Did yours spread? Yes or no?

Bonus: doctors often splint an injured hand in exactly this duck shape (big knuckles bent about 70 to 90 degrees, fingers straight), so those straps stay stretched and can't shrink and stiffen the knuckles.
